purpose: Select a middle-load NSESche profile only by a fully paired, simultaneously revealed comparison of exact ready-frontier FaaSRank and two fixed FaaSRank-low/Orion-high queue routers against all nine frozen baselines.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E145-E149 were untouched V44 reserve members and E150-E154 are new; no tape, reference, online run, or metric from any of them existed when this plan was committed. E140-E144 and all earlier development cohorts are closed; E120-E129 remain sealed confirmation seeds.

diagnostic_basis.rejected_mechanism: Switching from exact FaaSRank to Hiku at low density reduced QPR in all five V44 seeds and throughput in four of five, despite affecting only a minority of active windows.
diagnostic_basis.queue_density_definition: current (pending_tasks + runnable_tasks) / node_count; tasks per node; no completed-request outcome or workload label
diagnostic_basis.mechanistic_hypothesis: Preserve exact FaaSRank throughout low pressure, including the QPR-dominant easy seed, and switch only high-pressure windows to the load-faithful Orion score that tracks the throughput-leading baseline.

frozen_faasrank_model.binding_requirement: Bind this exact artifact to the complete 45-run baseline manifest before any baseline execution. Candidate implementations use the same frozen constants and deterministic seed/frame context.

candidates.definition: Parent-complete frontier and the frozen baseline's exact deterministic epsilon=0.10 FaaSRank selection for every decision window.
Exact deterministic FaaSRank below 24 current pending+runnable tasks/node; load-faithful Orion at or above 24; parent-complete frontier.
Exact deterministic FaaSRank below 32 current pending+runnable tasks/node; load-faithful Orion at or above 32; parent-complete frontier.

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit this plan; make no further source or control commits; generate manifests; capture five tapes; bind identical tapes everywhere; bind the exact FaaSRank model to all 45 baselines; build all fifteen candidate references; run all 60 processes; require QC and joint pairing for every run; only then inspect throughput and QPR.

selection.winner_gate: One candidate must have a strictly larger five-seed arithmetic mean than each of the other eleven paired methods for throughput, finite-only QPR, and zero-completion-as-zero QPR simultaneously.

next_confirmation.closure_requirement: Frozen low, middle, and high NSESche profiles must each strictly beat the frozen baseline throughput and QPR thresholds on the holdout.
